title: Rossignol Recalls Snowboard Bindings Due to Strap Failure
summary: The t-nuts that attach the buckles to the straps on the snowboard bindings can detach, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,500 pairs.

title: Children's Board Skirts Recalled By Chelsea & Scott Ltd. Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint on the grommets of the skirts contains an excess level of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 600.

title: Cooper Lighting Recalls Emergency and Exit Lights; Could Fail to Stay Illuminated in an Emergency
summary: The lights can malfunction and not stay illuminated in the event of a power failure. This could result in a failure to provide adequate lighting to guide building occupants to an exit in an emergency. Units: About 9,000.

title: Atico International USA Recalls Personal Blenders Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: While placing the cup on or off the base of the blender, the blender can be inadvertently turned on, activating the blade. This can pose a serious laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 124,000.

title: Fire and Burn Hazards Prompt Recall of Gas Grills Sold at Lowe's Stores
summary: The cooking chamber of the grill can melt and/or ignite, posing a risk of fires and burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 24,000.

title: Fisher-Price Recalls Learning Pots and Pans™ Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Missing screws in the blue toy pan can cause the clear plastic cover to come loose and release small balls, presenting a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 15,000.

title: Progress Lighting Recalls Indoor Light Fixtures; Lights Can Unexpectedly Fall Posing an Impact Hazard
summary: The ceiling-mount assembly that supports the light fixture can fail, causing the fixture to unexpectedly fall and injure consumers. Units: About 6,000.

title: Children's Hooded Jackets with Drawstrings Recalled By Kids with Character Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 1,200.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by Raw Blue Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have drawstrings through the hood, which pose a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 5,740.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by Request Jeans Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The hoodies have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 1,200.

title: Baby Appleseed Recalls Cribs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The cribs fail to meet the federal safety standards for cribs. The cribs have two mattress support systems. The secondary mattress support, used for the lowest position, does not meet the full 26-inch minimum height in its lowest position, allowing children inside to crawl over the railing, posing a

title: Bicycle Pedals Recalled by Look Cycle; Pedals Can Break Causing Cyclists to Fall
summary: The steel axle inside the pedal can break, posing a fall hazard to cyclists. Units: About 80,000 (40,000 pairs).

title: DEWALT Recalls Cordless Brad Nailers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The nailer can operate when the lock-off (safety) is in the locked position. Also, the nailer can operate when the trigger is not pulled and the contact trip is depressed. The unexpected ejection of a nail poses a serious injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 14,000.

title: Halogen Work Lights Recalled by Harbor Freight Tools Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: The halogen work lights can overheat and melt, posing a risk of fire and electrical shock to consumers. Units: About 58,000.

title: Mother Hubbard's Cupboards Recalls Cribs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The cribs fail to meet the federal safety standards. The distance between the mattress support bracket in the lowest position and the top of the side rail in the highest position is less than the required 26 inches, posing a fall hazard to children who climb over the railing. Units: About 1,300.

title: Baby Hammocks Recalled by FlagHouse Inc. Due to Fall and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The hammock can flip over, posing a serious fall hazard and strangulation hazard to infants who get entrapped in the seat's restraint straps while upside down. Units: About 100.

title: Bonne Bell Recalls Children's Cosmetics Accessory Bags Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The metal clasps on the handle of the accessory bags contain excessive levels of lead, which is toxic if ingested and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 945,000.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts and Jackets with Drawstrings Recalled by Orioxi International Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts and jackets have drawstrings through the hood which pose a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 43,000.

title: Countertop Water Dispensers Recalled by Greenway Home Products Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: The internal heating element could overheat and drop molten metal through ventilation openings in the water dispenser's base onto the countertop, posing a fire hazard. The internal heating element also poses a shock hazard to consumers who touch it through the vents. Units: About 44,000.

title: GIA Instruments Recalls Polariscopes Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The polariscopes can have a ground wire missing, posing a risk of electrical shock to the user. Units: About 8,000.

title: Regal Lager Recalls to Repair Phil & Teds Strollers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The stroller's hinge locking mechanism poses a laceration hazard to the user folding and unfolding the strollers. Units: About 44,000 (This recall was first announced in May 2006).

title: Six Retailers Agree To Stop Sale and Recall Simplicity Bassinets Due To Strangulation Hazard
summary: If the fabric flap velcro is not properly re-secured when the flap is adjusted, an infant can slip through the opening and become entrapped in the metal bars and suffocate. Units: About 900,000.

title: Wooden Infant Toys Recalled by Habermaass Corp. Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The wooden rattles, pacifier holders, and stroller toys contain small pieces including glued-on mirrors and/or prisms that can detach, posing a choking hazard to infants. The head of the ladybug puzzle pieces also poses a choking hazard. Units: About 118,000.

title: Goodman Company Recalls Air Conditioner/Heat Pump (PTAC) Units Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The PTAC's power cords can overheat, posing a burn or fire hazard. Units: About 30,000.

title: Indoor Lighting Fixtures Recalled by Lithonia Lighting Due to Impact Hazard
summary: The glass reflector can separate from the fixture and fall, posing a risk of injury to consumers below the fixture. Units: About 1,400.

title: Coffee Makers Recalled by Sears Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The wiring in the coffee maker can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 145,000.

title: IMS Recalls Car Chargers Used With Halogen Spotlights Sold at Sears and K-Mart Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The car charger is incompatible with the spotlight's battery, which can cause it to overcharge inside of a vehicle and pose a fire or burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 210,000.

title: Stroller Activity Bars Recalled by International Playthings Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The shiny material on the elephant's ear on the activity bar can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 10,000.

title: Power Light Modules Recalled by GCI Technologies Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: Internal wiring in the module's circuit boards is incorrectly installed, posing a risk of an electrical fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 7,500.

title: Cervelo SA Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The fork's steerer can break during normal use, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer serious injuries. Units: About 5,800.

title: Gardner Bender Recalls Electrical Wire Splices Due to Shock and Fire Hazards
summary: When crimped, the splice can fail to hold the wires adequately together, posing a shock and fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 53,000.

title: Steam Cleaners Recalled by Thane International Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Steam can escape from the handle and trigger of the steam cleaner, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 134,000.

title: Venmar CES Inc. Recalls Heat Recovery Ventilators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The motors in these units can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,400.

title: Electra Bicycle Company Expands Recall of Amsterdam Bicycles; Chain Can Derail and Pose Injury Risk to Riders
summary: The interior alignment tabs of the bicycle's chainguard can be pushed against the chain causing it to derail, which poses a risk of injury to riders. Units: About 1,500 (This recall was first announced in July 2008).

title: Flame Weeders Recalled by Gardener's Supply Co. Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The two-piece brass control valve can separate between the flame weeder and the propane tank, and allow propane to leak from the tank. This poses fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 2,000.

title: Hobbico Inc. Recalls Batteries Used In Radio-Controlled Helicopters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The rechargeable battery can overheat and catch fire while charging, igniting nearby combustible materials. This poses a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 11,000.
